annotations.title: Sign the person out (revoke the sessions)

description: Signs the person out: scope global (default) revokes every session of the account on every device, local only the session of this token. The access token is refused from then on; the person needs a new e-mail sign-in link. Saved favourites, lists and watches stay.

scope.description: global (every device, default) or local (this session).

name: sign_out
